name: Tabmint – Product Tabs for WooCommerce
author: kislaplabs

sections.description:
Tabmint adds extra tabs to your WooCommerce product pages, such as Size Guide, Shipping, Care Instructions, FAQ or Warranty, and keeps them easy to manage as your catalog grows.

Moving from Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce? Tabmint finds your existing tabs and imports them in one click: product tabs, saved tabs, and saved tabs shown on all products or on categories. Your old data is never changed or deleted, and the import is safe to run again.

Features

  • Per-product tabs with the full WordPress editor: formatting, images, media, embeds and shortcodes.
  • Saved tabs: write a tab once, add it to many products, and edit it in one place.
  • Show a saved tab automatically on every product, or on products in selected categories or tags (including their sub-categories).
  • Hide a tab on one product even when it is set to show on all products.
  • Drag and drop to reorder tabs on each product.
  • Hide the default tabs (Description, Additional information, Reviews) per product.
  • One-click import from Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce, with a progress bar for large stores and a WP-CLI command.
  • Works with your theme’s existing tab styling. No extra CSS or JavaScript on the front end.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Duplicating a product copies its tabs.

For developers

  • tabmint_product_tabs filter: change the resolved tabs for a product.
  • tabmint_show_tab_heading filter: hide the heading printed inside each tab panel.
  • tabmint_use_the_content_filter filter: render tab content through the_content.
  • WP-CLI: wp tabmint import-yikes [--dry-run] [--batch=<size>].
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Tabmint from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Edit a product and open Product data → Custom Tabs to add tabs.
  3. Create reusable tabs in Products → Saved Tabs.
  4. Coming from Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce? Go to Products → Tabmint and click Import tabs. Check a few products, then deactivate the old plugin.
sections.faq:
Will importing change or delete my old tabs?

No. The import only copies tabs into Tabmint. Your old plugin’s data stays as it is, so you can compare and switch back if you need to.

Why do I see some tabs twice after importing?

The old plugin is still active and showing its own copy. Deactivate Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce once you have checked your products.

Does it work with my theme?

Tabmint adds tabs through WooCommerce’s standard product tabs system, so they look like your theme’s existing Description and Reviews tabs.

Can I use shortcodes and embeds in tabs?

Yes. Tab content supports formatting, images, shortcodes and embeds like YouTube videos.

What happens to my tabs if I delete the plugin?

They are kept unless you tick “Delete all Tabmint tabs and settings when the plugin is deleted” in Products → Tabmint.
